shortDescription: Manages Remote Copy Group on VSP block storage systems.

options.name: connection_info
options.description: Information required to establish a connection to the storage system.

options.name: secondary_connection_info
options.description: Information required to establish a connection to the secondary storage system.

options.name: spec
options.description: Specification for the Remote Copy Group task.

options.name: state
options.description: - The level of the Remote Copy Group pairs task. - Choices are C(present), C(absent), C(split), C(resync), C(swap_split), C(swap_resync), C(takeover).

options.name: storage_system_info
options.description: Information about the storage system. This field is an optional field.
